value.content: {"id": "portswigger_jwt", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "jwt", "category": "PortSwigger Web Security: JSON Web Token (JWT) Attacks", "name": "JSON Web Token (JWT) Cryptographic & Header Flaws Methodology", "cwe": "CWE-1270", "owasp_category": "A07:2021 - Identification and Authentication Failures", "signals": ["none_algorithm_accepted", "weak_hmac_secret", "jwk_header_injection", "jku_header_injection", "kid_path_traversal_or_sqli", "algorithm_confusion_rs256_to_hs256"], "verification_strategy": "Decode JWT header and payload. Test changing alg to 'none' and stripping signature. Test embedding an attacker-controlled public key using the JWK header. Test algorithm confusion by signing the token using the server's public key with HMAC-SHA256 (HS256). Audit the 'kid' (Key ID) header for path traversal.", "evidence_requirements": ["none_alg_acceptance_proof", "tampered_claims_accepted", "jwt_cracked_secret_evidence"], "tools": [{"tool": "jwt_tool", "cmd": "python3 jwt_tool.py <TOKEN> -X a", "desc": "Comprehensive JWT vulnerability auditor testing alg:none, JWK injection, and key confusion"}, {"tool": "AutonomousBrain (JWT Auditor)", "cmd": "AutonomousBrain.audit_jwt(token)", "desc": "Decodes tokens and audits header parameters (kid, jku, jwk, alg) for insecure defaults"}], "remediation": "Do not trust the 'alg' header provided by the client. Explicitly enforce the expected signature algorithm on the server. Reject tokens with alg='none' and use strong, unpredictable signing keys.", "description": "PortSwigger JWT labs cover bypassing signature verification via alg:none, cracking weak HMAC secrets, header parameter injections (JWK, JKU, KID), and algorithm confusion attacks converting RS256 to HS256."}
